meta.notes: FakeTensor 'Verified' means the symbolic forward pass completed without a shape/size RuntimeError. It does NOT prove correctness of the logic — only that tensor shapes are consistent with the declared input shapes. This may inflate Verified counts for blocks whose shape bugs are only triggered by specific runtime values, not by shape alone.
